title: brachyglottis brunonis
intro: Brachyglottis brunonis, commonly known as the bronze fern, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to New Zealand. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Brachyglottis brunonis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, which may help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
